units.known_address_notes: Code4rena Mar-2023 contest over KangarooVault / LiquidityPool / PowerPerp on Optimism. The public report contains four 0x addresses but all are test fixtures inside warden PoCs (Synthetix PerpsV2MarketSettings 0x0979…4Ad1, mock vault-token holders); none are Polynomial deployments. C4 audit repo is not public, Polynomial-Protocol org has no v1 perps repo with an address book, and Optimism Blockscout/Etherscan name search is unavailable. Contract identities (KangarooVault, LiquidityPool) confirme
